title: Kuberwastaken/claurst
claim: Kuberwastaken/claurst — Agentic Coding for Builders who Ship
why_good: Another agentic-coding CLI with a slogan but a thin, undifferentiated pitch — hard to tell what it does better than the pack.
value: No clear wedge to charge for yet; it competes on vibes in a saturated coding-agent field.
risk: Undifferentiated in a brutal category owned by Claude Code / Cursor / Codex; needs a real reason to exist.

zh.claim: Kuberwastaken/claurst —— 给"能交付的 Builder"的智能体编码工具。
zh.why_good: 又一个有口号但定位单薄、没差异化的智能体编码 CLI——很难说它比同类强在哪。
zh.value: 还没有能收费的清晰切口;在饱和的编码 agent 里靠氛围竞争。
zh.risk: 在 Claude Code/Cursor/Codex 主宰的残酷品类里没差异化;需要一个真正存在的理由。
